shape.annual_median_x.spec: same errors aggregated to annual frequency, all 12 series -- NOT the same sample as shape.monthly_median_x's n=10 (BOPGEXP/BOPGIMP excluded there); see shape.annual_median_x_matched for the matched-sample comparison

shape.annual_median_x_matched.spec: same errors aggregated to annual frequency, restricted to the same 10 series shape.monthly_median_x uses (excludes BOPGEXP/BOPGIMP, which have no 2020-04 evaluation month) -- the like-for-like counterpart to the MONTHLY->ANNUAL dilution claim; shape.annual_median_x itself is the unmatched, all-12-series figure

shape.hardest_2020.spec: series whose hardest month falls anywhere in calendar 2020 (not just April) -- currently identical to shape.hardest_april2020 by coincidence, not by construction

shape.hardest_april2020.spec: series whose single hardest month is April 2020; difficulty = min scaled abs error over models

shape.hardest_gfc.spec: series whose hardest month falls in calendar 2008-09

shape.monthly_max_x.spec: largest April-2020 multiple across series; full precision, round once at render

shape.monthly_median_x.spec: median April-2020 difficulty divided by that series' median month; n=10 (BOPGEXP/BOPGIMP have no 2020-04 evaluation month, so this is a 10-of-12-series sample -- see shape.annual_median_x_matched for the like-for-like annual comparison on this same 10-series sample)
